subject: Q2 Brief: assumptions, OKR gateways & board packet next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 Brief: assumptions, OKR gateways & board packet next steps

Team — kicking off the thread to align on the investor/board packet and the OKR checkpoint narrative we want to present at the QBR. Key asks below: 

1) Confirm the final OKR snapshot to show (we have three variants in the tracker). Which KPI gating criteria do we present as "on-track" vs "at-risk"?
2) Agree on the top-three operational risks and mitigation bullets for the packet.
3) Finalize timeline to lock deck and who owns investor-facing send + follow-up.

Attached are: Q2_board_packet_v1.pdf (annotated), OKR_checkpoint_tracker.xlsx, and an exec one-pager. I used conservative assumptions for revenue guidance in slide 4 — flagged in comments.

Proposed timeline: internal freeze by Tue 9 Mar EOD PST, doc send to investors Wed 10 Mar, dry run Thu 11 Mar. If we want to push any ask to the board, call it out in subject.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategy, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: Q2_board_packet_v1.pdf (pdf), OKR_checkpoint_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 Brief: assumptions, OKR gateways & board packet next steps

Thanks Naomi — quick read. A few notes inline and a couple of higher-level asks: 

- OKR snapshot: recommend variant B (shows conservative ARR near-term but highlights mid-term efficiency gains). I'll mark the specific rows in OKR_checkpoint_tracker.xlsx.
- Risks: prioritize (1) model latency/regressions, (2) Dedicated capacity procurement lag, (3) enterprise contract timelines. Add one sentence on our fallback plan (model routing to smaller variants).
- Timeline: Tue freeze is tight given legal needs for the partner appendix. Can we move internal freeze to Wed 10 Mar EOD PST and still send Thu 11 Mar? If not, I'll escalate to legal.

Also, slide 9 (ops cost assumptions) needs one more data point from finance — looping in Lauren for that number.

-Jonas

Appreciate the quick reads. Update below after internal sync with finance/legal: 

- Freeze moved: internal freeze -> Wed 10 Mar 5pm PST (legal needs time for partner appendix). I updated the timeline in the Drive folder.
- OKR: we'll go with Jonas' variant B for the packet. I've pulled the "on-track"/"at-risk" coloring into the deck (slide 7).
- Risks: added the fallback line about routing to smaller model variants and a short note on Dedicated procurement cadence (slide 12).

I've uploaded Q2_board_packet_v1.1.pdf with inline replies and exec_summary_onepager.docx. Please review the annotated slides and leave comments in Drive — I'll incorporate Monday morning.

Naomi

Attachments: Q2_board_packet_v1.1.pdf (pdf), exec_summary_onepager.docx (docx)

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 Brief: assumptions, OKR gateways & board packet next steps

I've reviewed the updated deck (v1.1). A couple of suggested edits: 

- Slide 4 revenue assumptions: replace the projected MRR number with the finance-verified figure (see comments on slide). I'll attach a clean data table in the Drive.
- Slide 11 (product roadmap): tighten the language around Dedicated rollout to avoid calendaring legal expectations — suggest: "pilot availability Q3, GA timing dependent on procurement".
- Slide 14 (asks): reframe the investor ask to be more operational (resource consent) vs capital ask — keep the dollar ask out unless we have board approval.

I left specific comment pins in the Drive file and added a short redline copy in exec_summary_onepager.docx.

-Lauren

Next steps (short):
- Naomi: finalize and export deck as PDF v1.3 by Wed 10 Mar 10:00 PST and trigger the investor send (Samantha Rhodes / Conner Hill) — include the one-pager and ask doc.
- Jonas: run the dry rehearsal Thu 11 Mar 9:00 PST (calendar invite sent).
- Legal: final appendix to be uploaded to Drive by Wed 10 Mar 17:00 PST.

If no objections, we'll proceed on this plan. Great work team.

-Marissa
